dialogues.jp:
「……止めておいた方が、いいんじゃないんで
　すか？」

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「まあまあ、ちょっと待ちなさいって。もう少
　しで終わるから」
dialogues.en: "Just give me a minute. I'm nearly done."
dialogues.text: "Just give me a minute. I'm nearly done."

dialogues.jp:
ストップウォッチみたいな機械に向き合った暦
先生は、顔も上げない。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei's doing something with some kind of machine
that looks like a stopwatch.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei's doing something with some kind of machine
that looks like a stopwatch.

dialogues.jp:
「そもそも、何で、俺まで付き合わせるんで
　す？」

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「そりゃ、やっぱり学園七不思議を探るからに
　は心配だからね。女二人じゃ。君は少なくと
　も男ではあるから」
dialogues.en:
"That's because it's not a good idea to investigate one of
the seven wonders of the school with only two girls. At
least you're a guy."
dialogues.text:
"That's because it's not a good idea to investigate one of
the seven wonders of the school with only two girls. At
least you're a guy."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「委員会の仕事なのに、付き合わせちゃってご
　めんね。でも、頼りにしてるよ朝倉君」
dialogues.en:
"I'm sorry to drag you into this, Asakura-kun. I'm counting
on you."
dialogues.text:
"I'm sorry to drag you into this, Asakura-kun. I'm counting
on you."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「……よし。微調整終わりっと」

プラスのドライバーを置き、暦先生が立ち上が
る。手には先ほどまでいじっていた謎の機械を
持っている。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei put down a screwdriver and stood up. She had
the machine that she had just been working on.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei put down a screwdriver and stood up. She had
the machine that she had just been working on.

dialogues.jp:
「……そんなんで、ほんとに居場所が分かるん
　ですか？」
dialogues.en: "......Is this really going to tell us where it is?"
dialogues.text: "......Is this really going to tell us where it is?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、見てなさいって。たとえ地獄の底で鳴
　らしていたとしても、探知するんだから」
dialogues.en:
"You can watch it with your eyes. It'll find it even if it's
coming from under the ground."
dialogues.text:
"You can watch it with your eyes. It'll find it even if it's
coming from under the ground."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「それじゃ、行きましょかね」

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「れっつらゴー」

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「でも、先生。ほんとに信じてるんですか？
　学園の七不思議なんて……」
dialogues.en:
"But really. Do you really believe it? The seven wonders of
the school......?"
dialogues.text:
"But really. Do you really believe it? The seven wonders of
the school......?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「別に信じてはいない。ただ、目撃談が多い以
　上、無視は出来ないな」
dialogues.en:
"Not really. But I can't just ignore it, as it's been seen
so many times."
dialogues.text:
"Not really. But I can't just ignore it, as it's been seen
so many times."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「目撃っていうか、｛ちょうげき／聴撃｝っていうのかな、この
　場合」
dialogues.en: "It's more like it's been heard in this case."
dialogues.text: "It's more like it's been heard in this case."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「だって、見てる訳じゃないもんね」
ぐっと、親指を突き立てる。
dialogues.en: She gave me a thumbs up.
dialogues.text: She gave me a thumbs up.

dialogues.jp: 「……はあ、さいですか」
どっちでもええわ、んなもん。

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「お、反応があったよ」

ピコン――と、ストップウォッチらしき液晶が
光る……凝ってるな。
dialogues.en:
Something's flashing on the stopwatch-like machine......
quite impressive.
dialogues.text:
Something's flashing on the stopwatch-like machine......
quite impressive.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「屋上……か。やっぱり変だね。大方の学生が
　帰ったこの時間に……」
dialogues.en:
"The rooftop...... Strange. Most of the students are already
gone by now......"
dialogues.text:
"The rooftop...... Strange. Most of the students are already
gone by now......"

dialogues.jp:
そんな時間に、何で俺は学園に残ってるんでしょ
うか？
dialogues.en: Why am I here at this kind of hour?
dialogues.text: Why am I here at this kind of hour?

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「さ、行こうよ」

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ちょ、ちょっと、何で背中を押してくるの
　さ？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, why are you pushing me forward?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, why are you pushing me forward?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「え？　い、いやあ、やっぱり怖いかな……な
　んて」
dialogues.en: "Pardon? Well, I'm kind of scared...... you know."
dialogues.text: "Pardon? Well, I'm kind of scared...... you know."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……盾ですか、俺は」

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「気が付くのが遅いねえ」
嫌な笑顔で暦先生が笑う。

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「さ、行くよ。敵は屋上にあり、だ」
チャカポコチャカポコ。
スカラカチャカポコ……。

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「すー……すー……」

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「すー……すー……」

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「……だから、止めておいた方がいいって言っ
　たんですよ」
dialogues.en: "......I told you we shouldn't do this."
dialogues.text: "......I told you we shouldn't do this."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あ、ごめんなさい、ごめんなさい……」
ぺこぺこ。ぺこぺこ。

風見学園七不思議の一つ、“木琴の怪”は何と
も腰が低かった。
dialogues.en:
One of the seven wonders of our school, 'The mystery of the
xylophone' was very modest.
dialogues.text:
One of the seven wonders of our school, 'The mystery of the
xylophone' was very modest.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「すー……すー……」
◆学園七不思議──木琴◆

学園七不思議を突き止めるという暦先生とこと
りに、何故か付き合わされる俺。
dialogues.en:
I was asked to accompany Koyomi-sensei and Kotori to
investigate the seven wonders of the school.
dialogues.text:
I was asked to accompany Koyomi-sensei and Kotori to
investigate the seven wonders of the school.

dialogues.jp:
先生が作った機械で、怪の源──木琴の音源が、
屋上だって事を突き止めた。早速屋上へ向かう
俺達。
dialogues.en:
We found out that the sound of the xylophone was coming from
the roof, using the machine the teacher had engineered. We
headed to the roof.
dialogues.text:
We found out that the sound of the xylophone was coming from
the roof, using the machine the teacher had engineered. We
headed to the roof.

dialogues.jp: そこに居たのは、萌先輩だった……。
